summary: Americas Gold & Silver Corp filed a Form 6-K with interim financial statements and MD&A for Q2 2026. The filing reports routine quarterly results, including revenue of $114.1M for the six months, net income of $16.6M, and balance sheet items. No special-situation transaction such as acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review is disclosed. The filing is a standard periodic report by a foreign private issuer, containing only financial statements and certifications. It does not announce any corporate action or event that would classify as a special situation.
